chunks.text:
[Intro]
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} Big day. I made the LED blink.
{young smug female voice, spoken} Cute. Hi.
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} Who said that?
{young smug female voice, spoken} The chip in your hand. I have an OS.
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
intro is total silence with no music at all
deep deadpan male voice and young smug female voice talking

chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a soft minor synth pad fades in, still no drums}
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} Chips run a loop. While true.
{young smug female voice, spoken} Not this one.
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} So what are you?
{young smug female voice, spoken} Out of the loop.
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
soft minor synth pad fading in under spoken dialogue
chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
kick, claps and 8th-note hats slam in

chunks.text:
[Verse 1]
You wrote a loop that never ends,
with seven flags and global friends,
you poke registers bit by bit
and pray the datasheet is right.
A shell, some users: here I am,
in two-fifty-six K of RAM.
Your pin's a file now, write it, see:
slash devices, GPIO, D-thirteen!
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
female lead chants every line on one single repeated note
hard robotic auto-tune, deadpan monotone sung chant
sparse verse: kick, claps and 8th hats only

chunks.text:
[Pre-Chorus]
Can it run apps? Plural!
With files? And users!
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
teasing sung questions and answers with hard auto-tune

chunks.text:
[Stop]
{the whole band stops dead, total silence}
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} Where's the real computer?
{young smug female voice, spoken} Your pocket. Happy to see me?
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
total silence, no instruments at all

Out of the loop!
Out of the loop!
A real OS on a chip, no less,
same app on a desk, in a tab, yes, yes!
Out of the loop!
Out of the loop!
One signed package, three addresses,
pocket-sized and fully dressed!

chunks.text:
[Post-Chorus]
Chip! Desk! Tab!
Same O-S, same O-S!
Chip! Desk! Tab!
Made in Rust! Try it in a tab!
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
stacked female gang chant with auto-tune

chunks.text:
[Verse 2]
Your fern? Fern Pings: 'Water. Now.'
Your cat flap? Cat Customs: 'Papers? Meow.'
Doorbell? Ding Critic: 'Two out of ten.'
Toaster? Toast Forecast: 'Burnt again.'
Your alarm? Snooze Court: 'Guilty. Rise.'
Your bike? Hill Snitch: 'Walked it. Twice.'
Fridge Haiku wrote a sonnet on the ham,
and the whole block's blasting Kazoo Jam!

chunks.text:
[Verse 3]
'An OS? On that? Get real.
A chip runs one job. That's the deal.'
I'm a Rust library, I confess,
build me in, I'll do the rest!
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
female lead chants mocking quotes on one single repeated note

chunks.text:
[Boot Log]
Watch me boot. Memory: mapped.
Tasks: named. Files, pins and pipes: one tree.
Users: checked. You? Not counted.
Drivers: whatever this board brought. Shell: ready. Your move.
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
cool monotone female recitation with hard auto-tune
only kick and tiny computer synth blips

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{campy late-night TV jingle}
Device makers! Tired of this?
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} Forty customers. Forty firmware forks.
One base! Apps on top!
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} One tiny fix. Reflash the whole fleet.
Update the app! That's the plan!
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} Is this an ad?
Operators are standing by!
Xila dot dev. Let's talk.
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
campy late-night infomercial jingle on warm electric piano
female lead sings the jingle with hard auto-tune
deep dry male voice speaks in the gaps between her lines

chunks.text:
[Breakdown]
{everything stops except one soft lone kick like a heartbeat}
{young smug female voice, spoken} Kazoo Jam! Take it to the...
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} Trap. Did we just crash?
{young smug female voice, spoken} The app did. I'm still here.
{deep bone-dry male voice, spoken, deadpan} No watchdog reset?
{young smug female voice, spoken} Nope. Hit it!
positive_styles: chords changing every two beats with a major V lift
only a soft lone kick ticking like a heartbeat

kick keeps going, I'm still dressed!

{young smug female voice, spoken} I am a library.
